query:
-- Ohio: Amy Acton (D) vs Vivek Ramaswamy (R)
UPDATE governor_races
SET dem_previous_office = 'Ohio Department of Health Director (2019-2020)',
    rep_previous_office = 'Biotech entrepreneur; 2024 presidential candidate',
    dem_bio = 'Former Ohio public health director who led COVID-19 response. Running on healthcare and education.',
    rep_bio = 'Biotech billionaire and former 2024 presidential candidate. Trump-endorsed. Pledged to cut state government by 20%.',
    notes = 'Ramaswamy won R primary (98.7% in). Acton won D primary. Rated Lean R.',
    status = 'Voting',
    pct_reporting = 98.70
WHERE state_code = 'OH';

-- Oregon: Tina Kotek (D, incumbent) vs Christine Drazan (R)
UPDATE governor_races
SET dem_previous_office = 'Governor of Oregon (2023-present)',
    rep_previous_office = 'Oregon House Republican Leader (2019-2023)',
    dem_bio = 'Incumbent Democratic governor. First openly lesbian governor in U.S. history. Former Oregon House Speaker.',
    rep_bio = 'Former Oregon House Republican Leader. Lost 2022 governor race to Kotek by 3 points. Running a rematch.',
    notes = 'Kotek won D primary (72.8% in). Drazan won R primary. Rematch of 2022 race. Rated Solid D.',
    status = 'Voting',
    pct_reporting = 72.80
WHERE state_code = 'OR';

-- Pennsylvania: Josh Shapiro (D, incumbent) vs Stacy Garrity (R)
UPDATE governor_races
SET dem_previous_office = 'Governor of Pennsylvania (2023-present)',
    rep_previous_office = 'Pennsylvania State Treasurer (2021-present)',
    dem_bio = 'Incumbent Democratic governor. Former state attorney general. Won 2022 race by 14.8 points.',
    rep_bio = 'Pennsylvania State Treasurer and retired Army colonel. Trump-endorsed. First Republican to win statewide in PA since 2010.',
    notes = 'Both primaries uncontested. Shapiro is the heavy favorite. Rated Solid D.',
    status = 'Voting',
    pct_reporting = 96.00
WHERE state_code = 'PA';
